title: Criteria/matrix mismatch
text: Criteria/matrix mismatch: this business rule requires at least two runs per configuration for comparative recall and cost claims, while AC15(d) and the claim-admissibility matrix permit a claim from one matched run per configuration and impose equal run counts only when runs are repeated. Specify whether one matched run is admissible and align every mirror surface.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in c1b6b71, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
